summary: LocalSetup 5.7.1 clarifies the canonical GitHub repository name as CruxExperts/LocalSetup while preserving established URL paths and technical identifiers.

highlights.text: **Canonical repository spelling:** The maintainer policy identifies `CruxExperts/LocalSetup` as the GitHub repository name and preserves existing repository URL paths and compatibility identifiers.

compatibility: Existing repository URL paths, the framework command, and the Python distribution keep their established spelling.
This documentation clarification requires no installation or configuration migration.
update: Update a registered installation using the [quickstart instructions](https://github.com/CruxExperts/localsetup/blob/v5.7.1/ls/docs/QUICKSTART.md#update).
verification: Download `localsetup-v5.7.1.tar.gz`, its `.sha256` checksum, and `.cdx.json` SBOM sidecar together. Follow the [release guide verification steps](https://github.com/CruxExperts/localsetup/blob/v5.7.1/ls/docs/releases/5.7.1.md#verify-the-download) to run `verify-release` and confirm the signed `v5.7.1` tag points to the release commit.
No runtime or installer behavior changes in this documentation update.
